_comment: Shipped TTS defaults (template). User overrides live in the non-tracked config under plugins.tts and win over these values; edit them in Settings > Text-to-speech (GET/POST /v1/tts/config), which validates each one. The voice here is the DEFAULT: a browser that picks its own voice in chat keeps that pick locally. Do not put personal model choices in tracked files - override here.
_dtype_note: dtype 'auto' picks fp32 (clean audio - the q8 quantized model produced cracks/pings on the WASM path). Set 'q8' or 'fp16' for a smaller/faster but lower-quality download, or 'fp32' explicitly.
